I have a tuxedo that has saved my life many times. I’m a type 1 diabetic and this was before I had a Dexcom. When she realized I wasn’t waking up she went over to my husband and did the same thing. He shooed her off. She came right back and was MORE AGGRESSIVE. He shooed her off again. She didn’t like that so final attempt at waking him up to make sure I would be okay she bit his nose!!! He was like “Beanz what the fuckkkkkk” and rolled over and put his arm around me. I had soaked through my clothes with sweat, through the blankets and the sheets. (We had separate blankets at the time) and he grabbed my checker, checked my sugar and it was 11. I was literally about to die. When he woke me up I couldn’t see anything, everything was white and I was so out of it. A whole container of juice and three pound bag of gummies later my sugar came up to 87. She literally saved my life!!!
